title: The feedback check finds an item's home in the repo it belongs to, not only the cwd's
why: Possible false alarm (coordinator, Nov 1 11:35 CST): with its cwd in the banchi checkout, the feedback check (#940) reported 'home is not a file that git tracks on any branch' for five inbox items whose homes (docs/decisions/session-tiers.md, docs/decisions/owner-feedback-inbox.md, docs/debts/inbox-saves-other-notices.md) are tracked in claude-settings. The check resolves a home against the cwd's repo only.
note: Triage judged it a note (roles-findings-are-debts-or-notes): first case, and only a session that works across repos meets it. It becomes a debt if it repeats. A record lane adds one line to docs/debts/notes.md, slug feedback-home-resolves-cwd, pointing to decision owner-feedback-inbox and naming hooks/feedback_guard.py, with the fix idea: resolve against the session's repo roots, or let a home name its repo. Done check: the line is in notes.md and ste-lint passes. Needs no answer.
